title: ScenarioEnvelope
description: Input envelope for the WASM postflop CFR solver. Generated by backend/app/scenario/builder.py and consumed by solver-wasm/src/envelope.rs. Both sides must stay in sync.

board.description: Community cards at the start of the postflop street. Each card is a 2-char string rank+suit (e.g. "As", "Td", "9c").

pot_bb.description: Pot at the start of the street (before any postflop action), in big blinds.

effective_stack_bb.description: Effective stack between OOP and IP at the start of the street, in big blinds.

oop_player.description: Position label of the out-of-position player (e.g. "BB", "UTG").

ip_player.description: Position label of the in-position player (e.g. "BTN", "CO").

hero_position.description: Optional: hero's position. Required if only hero_range/villain_range are provided (not oop_range/ip_range).

oop_range.description: OOP player's hand class → weight map (preferred over hero_range/villain_range).

ip_range.description: IP player's hand class → weight map (preferred over hero_range/villain_range).

hero_range.description: Hero's hand class → weight map. Requires hero_position to disambiguate OOP/IP.

villain_range.description: Villain's hand class → weight map. Requires hero_position to disambiguate OOP/IP.

handClassWeights.description: Map from PIO-style hand class strings (e.g. "AKs", "QQ", "AKo") to weights in [0.0, 1.0].

flop.description: Bet sizes available on the flop as pot-percent strings (e.g. "33%") or "a" for all-in.

turn.description: Bet sizes available on the turn.

river.description: Bet sizes available on the river.

allin_always.description: If true, an all-in option is appended to every street's bet list.
